moving_frame_zero_clearance_range.interpretation: For this linear moving-frame model and nonnegative clearance, the excess-field decay length cannot exceed D/v_rel.

front_vs_diffusion_time_over_70um.warning: Uses cross-paper v as a proxy for v_rel and FCS D values; exact same-condition material-frame quantities must be acquired.
